annotations.exact_quote: Sparse nonnegative matrix factorization (SNMF) aims to factorize a data matrix into two optimized nonnegative sparse factor matrices
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确以稀疏非负矩阵分解为核心方法，将数据矩阵分解为非负因子矩阵。

annotations.exact_quote: jointly makes two factor matrices nonparametric and sparse
annotations.reason_zh: 方法使两个因子矩阵稀疏，以少量潜在因子/基表示数据，属于稀疏表示机制。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose a doubly sparse nonparametric NMF framework to mitigate this issue by using dependent Indian buffet processes (dIBP).
annotations.reason_zh: 采用依赖印度自助过程这一贝叶斯非参数先验/生成过程对因子矩阵建模，属于贝叶斯概率模型框架。
